scenarios.name: Create a new Engine Component car part with all dropdown fields

steps.text: the user is logged in to Salesforce
the user navigates to the Car Parts application
the user is on the Car Parts list view
the user clicks the "New" button
the Car Part creation form should be displayed
the user enters "Turbocharger Assembly - GT3582R" in the "Part Name" field
the user enters "ENG-TURBO-3582R-001" in the "Part Number" field
the user selects "Engine Components" from the "Part Category" dropdown
the dependent "Part Sub-Category" dropdown refreshes
the user selects "Turbocharger" from the "Part Sub-Category" dropdown
the user selects "BorgWarner" from the "Manufacturer" dropdown
the user selects "New" from the "Condition" dropdown
the user enters "2499.99" in the "Unit Price" field
the user enters "25" in the "Stock Quantity" field
the user selects "Toyota" from the "Vehicle Make" dropdown
the user selects "2015-2019" from the "Model Year Range" dropdown
the user selects "In Stock" from the "Availability Status" dropdown
the user selects "Warehouse A - North" from the "Warehouse Location" dropdown
the user selects "OEM" from the "Quality Grade" dropdown
the user selects "Freight / LTL" from the "Shipping Class" dropdown
the user selects "2-Year Limited" from the "Warranty Type" dropdown
the user selects "USD" from the "Currency" dropdown
the user enters the description in the "Description" field
the user clicks the "Save" button
a success toast message "was created" should be displayed
the Car Part record page should show "Turbocharger Assembly - GT3582R"
the "Part Category" field should display "Engine Components"
the "Manufacturer" field should display "BorgWarner"
the "Condition" field should display "New"

scenarios.name: Edit an existing Car Part and update dropdown fields

steps.text: the user is on the Car Parts list view
the user searches for "Turbocharger Assembly" in the list
the user opens the first matching record
the user clicks the "Edit" button
the user changes the "Condition" dropdown to "Refurbished"
the user changes the "Availability Status" dropdown to "Low Stock"
the user changes the "Warehouse Location" dropdown to "Warehouse D - West"
the user changes the "Quality Grade" dropdown to "Aftermarket Premium"
the user updates the "Unit Price" field to "1899.99"
the user updates the "Stock Quantity" field to "10"
the user clicks the "Save" button
a success toast message "was saved" should be displayed
the "Condition" field should display "Refurbished"
the "Availability Status" field should display "Low Stock"
